SEN.note: Nothing on AI harms rules or authority.
No government AI system tendered, piloted or in service.
No AI tool in a sector system stated.
The AI & Digital Factory programme is named with no builder, funder or site.
A biometric digital identity is only promised; no authentication service stated.
Nothing on a civil register to ID link.
Sovereignty is stated in general terms; no plan or rule on state data or systems named.

facts.fact: President Bassirou Diomaye Faye officially launched Senegal's new digital strategy, the Technological New Deal, on 24 February 2025, under the Senegal 2050 agenda, with a Digital Master Plan of twelve priority programmes and 50 flagship projects, per the Presidency.

systems.platform: national digital strategy with Digital Master Plan
systems.owner: Presidency; Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital Affairs

SEN.note: A single citizen portal is only promised; no service online stated.
Nothing on an ID number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.
A unique biometric digital identity is only promised, with no builder or pilot stated.
Nothing on international bandwidth; only universal internet access is promised.
Cadastral and land digitisation is named only as a priority.
Dematerialised civil status is named only as a priority.
Online tax payment is only promised on a future platform.

facts.fact: President Faye's speech commits to updating and operationalising Senegal's existing Startup Act, including labelling and an incentive framework.

SEN.note: An incubation programme is only promised; no hub named.
